notes.title: Update 1.8 and Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Today is my Birthday Update 1.8[/b]

Bug fixes:
1) Load game doesn't work after death ( Level Woods )
2) Letters duplicates  ( Level Woods )
3) Train Lever was not working  (Level Catacombs )
4) Loading times after (Restart and load game) become 50% faster
5) Blinking texts at the Dorothy battle.
6) Barney repeated the same text after protagonist death  ( Level Woods )
6) Minor inconveniences.

Added:
1) Easy mode for beginners (Additional hints, infinite stamina, important objects are marked , five camara 
    flashes per charge, instead of two )
2) Several new environment models.


Thanl you and have fun!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Game Improvements and Bug Fixes 1.7
notes.notes:
Today is my Birthday Update 1.7ːsteamhappyː

Fixes include:
1) William would see you through the staircase, now the player can hide under the stairs.
2) Picking up objects did not always work with the first button press. This issue was addressed and fixed. 
3) Notes and newspapers were missing in inventory when you move to the next chapter.
4) Prisoners in catacombs couldn't open all the doors. 
5) Some enemies went into a loop animation after a camera flash. 
6) History of photos in your local AppData are deleted after New game is started. 
7) Increased Stamina Rechange speed +5, which will provide a better experience for the players.
8) Warning dialogue when pressing Restart was not showing in some cases. 
9) Some evidence could be photographed twice. 
10) FPS drops in some places.

notes.title: Update and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello! Thank you all for your comments and feedback.[/h2]
We made a bunch of changes that we hope makes your experience even more fun. We'd also like to do something fun with the community and include you in the game.

[b]Fixes include:[/b]

1)	All voiceover texts are aligned. 
2)	Problems with picking up some objects.
3)	Cache is no longer stored on player PC.
4)	Performance optimization.
5)	Memory Optimization to prevent crashes.
6)	Resolution / window mode were not saved correctly.
7)	At the end of the second chapter, you could lock yourself in an elevator.
8)	Added tips and tricks in loading screens.
9)	New voiceover Barney B.
10)	Player Hints, additional Protagonist lines.
11)	The pause did not work when the camera is in hands.
12)	Increased stamina regeneration.
13)	Bosses health bar.
14)	Sometimes the prisoners from the catacombs did not see you.
15)	Sometimes the jump did not work.
16)	Increased tutorial display time.

notes.title: Crytivo Plays Today Is My Birthday
notes.notes:
[b]Crytivo plays Today Is My Birthday[/b], a classic horror experience for fans of the genre. 

Players are tossed into insurmountable odds with only a few tools at their disposal to escape death. Your own survival instincts, problem solving skills, and willingness to explore will shape your fate.

The game releases Friday October 30th just in time for Halloween. Wishlist today to be notified.

notes.title: ⭐Crytivo is proud to announce Roots of Pacha - a co-op, farming, and life simulation RPG set in the Stone Age.
notes.notes:
[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/zQKTReQ][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021448/354b4fe304270e739c51199c04c73ceebb48e324.gif[/img][/url]

Crytivo and Soda Den Studio are proud to unveil Roots of Pacha, an online co-op, farming, and life-simulation RPG set during the Stone Age. Grab your friends and some rocks (whichever is more useful) and start building the world’s first and finest farming village!

[url=https://youtu.be/mYEhKvcDhsY]Watch Announcement Trailer[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/mYEhKvcDhsY][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021448/707a55ef47a5ccd6fb5a022b29cf17e40476bfd0.png[/img][/url]

https://youtu.be/mYEhKvcDhsY


[b][h1]About the game[/h1][/b]

After roaming the prehistoric world, it’s time to settle down and build a village to stand for generations. Join with friends to develop technology, discover plants to farm, harvest crops, befriend and domesticate animals, and create a thriving stone age community. Find love, nurture relationships, and grow your community—and then celebrate and honor nature in glorious festivals! 
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021448/5c942faea5971109de5e91dfc544f95ead7cde50.gif[/img]
[i]Prehistoric ride sharing! Ride animals with your friends![/i]

[h1][b]Key Features:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Grow and harvest. Start your own farming revolution and invent the tools and techniques to build a prosperous village from nothing.
[*] 
[*] Explore an ancient world. A fertile, vibrant world awaits! Fish streams and rivers, discover unique flora and fauna, and mine the darkest caves for resources.
[*] 
[*] Join the clan. Work with the community, develop friendships, and even find love!
[*] 
[*] Grow your village. Help villagers develop ideas and discover new farming and crafting technology. Construct buildings, invite others into the clan, and transform your settlement into an agricultural marvel. 
[*] 
[*] Play with friends. Invite up to 3 friends to join your village. Live with them (or keep your distance), share talents and resources, and celebrate festivals, where each player can contribute to communal dinners or compete in fishing contests!   
[/list]

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021448/2038c9886628b3060763ffbe50198e7d6d43671f.gif[/img]
[i]How about taking your wolves out for an adventure?[/i]

[b]Release: Early 2021 
Platforms: Steam | Xbox | PS | Switch | Crytivo[/b]
